description: The system shall be available in both Spanish and English.
The system shall be available in Spanish and English, verified by a translator.
The system shall allow registering new users.
The system shall authenticate existing users via email.
The system shall allow users to log out.
The system shall allow logged-in users to view company profiles and their products.
A company shall be able to modify its public profile at any time.
A company shall be able to preview its public profile while editing.
A company shall have access to the system dashboard to use internal functionalities and view additional information.
A company shall be able to register a product so that it is visible on its public profile.
A company shall be able to register a route to link it to its products.
A user shall be able to return a product registered by a company using its routes.
Every route shall have an associated cost.
The user must be able to pay the route cost through the system when returning the product.
The system shall include an affiliation/plan system for companies.
The user interface must be intuitive and easy to use for non-technical users.
Usability testing with at least 10 representative users, achieving a minimum satisfaction score of 8/10.
The system must protect user information through secure authentication.
The system must pass security audits without critical vulnerabilities.
The system must have an uptime of 99.9% and be able to recover from failures in less than 1 hour.
Uptime monitoring demonstrating 99.9% uptime and disaster recovery tests meeting the specified recovery time.
The system must be easy to maintain and update with clear and complete documentation.
Complete and updated documentation, and average time for implementation of updates and troubleshooting not exceeding 2 hours.
The system must be compatible with common web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) and mobile devices.
Compatibility tests demonstrating functionality in major browsers and mobile devices.
The system must be scalable to handle an increase in the number of users and data volume.
Capacity to increase server resources and maintain performance with a 50% increase in workload.
Company products/routes/profile can only be editable and accessible by that company.
Verify that only the company user can access their products/routes/profile.
